material: Was Isaac Newton older than Albert Einstein?
work:
@q query
  where match
    relation "older_than"
    role subject "Isaac Newton"
    role object "Albert Einstein"
    polarity affirmed
  end

material: Is the capital of Kenya in Africa?
work:
@q query
  where all
    match
      relation "capital_of"
      role subject ?c
      role object "Kenya"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end

material: How many grams are in a kilogram?
work:
@q query
  select ?n
  where match
    relation "converts_to"
    role subject "kilogram"
    role topic "grams"
    role object ?n
    polarity affirmed
  end

material: Who was born first, Charles Darwin or Karl Marx?
work:
@q query
  select ?who
  compare any
    ?who equal "charles_darwin"
    ?who equal "karl_marx"
  end
  rank lowest ?t
  where match
    relation "born_on"
    role subject ?who
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end
